Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.analytics

Class StatisticsCalculator

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.analytics.StatisticsCalculator
public class StatisticsCalculator extends Object
Works out every figure in the reports from the session's events: active and idle time, compile and run counts, error frequencies, typing speed and the class and method timeline.
Author:
Haeley Parbhoo

    • activeMillis

      long activeMillis(List<TelemetryEvent> events, long start, long end)
      Works out how much of the session was active. A gap between events counts as active only if it is no longer than the idle threshold, and time spent typing in an edit burst is always active.
      Parameters:
      events - the events recorded in the session
      start - the start of the session in epoch milliseconds
      end - the end of the session in epoch milliseconds
      Returns:
      active time in milliseconds

    • typingCadenceCpm

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      characters per minute, or 0 with no typing
